method: Fresh-context gpt-6-astra agents, high reasoning requested; same model/configuration for paired executions. Each case is fictional. Multi-turn feedback was withheld until preceding actual response completed.
quality_blinding: Per-case X/Y order shuffled; reviewer received prompts/responses only, no skill, version mapping or expected answer.
reader_blinding: Only four documents, target audiences and reader questions; no source packet, conversation, skill or expected answers.
docx_version_evidence: Both runners reported the same version from their original read result, without rereading current files. Per-command source hashes were not captured.
baseline_generator_input_note: The a-run generator JSON intermediate was cleaned by its DOCX workflow. Exact user content survives in input.json and response.json; original JSON bytes are not claimed retained. The b-run JSON input and both actual DOCX outputs are retained.
